raw_segments.text: Fluorizal, thou dearest Perdita, with these forked thoughts I prithee darken not the mirtho
th feast, or I'll be thine my fair or not my father's, for I cannot be mine own nor
anything to any if I be not thine.
To this I am most constant, though destinies say no.
Be merry gentle, strangle such thoughts as these with anything that you behold the while.
Your guests are coming, lift up your countenance, as it were the day of celebration of that
nuptial which we too have sworn shall come.
